name: vizier
description: Turn app ideas into structured, agent-ready build plans

vizier.provider.description: LLM provider. 'anthropic' uses Claude; 'openai' uses any OpenAI-compatible API; 'omniroute' uses an OpenAI-compatible gateway that can auto-route/switch models (automode) while Vizier retains all context; 'ollama' uses a local Ollama server (no API key, fully on-prem).

vizier.anthropicApiKey.description: Your Anthropic API key for Claude

vizier.preferredModel.description: Which Claude model to use (when provider = anthropic)

vizier.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Base URL of your local Ollama server (when provider = ollama). No API key is required; runs fully on-prem.

vizier.ollamaModel.description: Model id pulled locally in Ollama (when provider = ollama), e.g. llama3.2, qwen2.5-coder:7b, deepseek-r1:8b.

vizier.openaiApiKey.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible provider

vizier.openaiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or an OpenRouter/omniroute endpoint)

vizier.openaiModel.description: Model id for the OpenAI-compatible provider

vizier.omnirouteApiKey.description: API key for the omniroute (OpenAI-compatible) gateway

vizier.omnirouteBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the omniroute gateway (set to your omniroute OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

vizier.omnirouteModel.description: Model for omniroute; 'auto' lets the gateway switch models (automode) while Vizier keeps context

vizier.planMonitorNarrative.description: When enabled, the plan-progress report includes an AI-written narrative. This is generated from plan metadata ONLY (task ids, titles, status counts) — never from your source code.

vizier.planMonitorOnStartup.description: Run a lightweight local scan on startup to populate the status-bar progress indicator when a plan exists.

vizier.codePrivacyMode.description: Privacy guarantee: when true (default), Vizier never transmits repository source code to any LLM. Plan-progress monitoring is always local-only regardless of this setting.

vizier.fallbackProvider.description: Optional secondary provider used automatically if the primary fails (circuit-breaker / failover). Leave empty to disable.

vizier.enableCache.description: Cache identical LLM requests (hashed) to a local temp dir to reduce cost and latency and improve reproducibility.

vizier.stableMode.description: Force temperature to 0 for reproducible, deterministic plan generation.

vizier.stageModels.description: Per-stage model overrides, e.g. { "classification": "gpt-4o-mini", "prd": "claude-opus-4-..." }. Right-sizes models per pipeline stage to cut cost/latency.

vizier.monthlyBudgetTokens.description: Soft monthly token budget (0 = unlimited). Generation throws BUDGET_EXCEEDED once the running total is reached. Tracked in VS Code global state.

vizier.verifyPlanWithGit.description: When checking plan progress, inspect git history for commits referencing task ids (local only).

vizier.verifyPlanWithTests.description: When checking plan progress, look for coverage reports and test files associated with expected task files (local only).

vizier.autoCommitPlan.description: After exporting a plan, create a git commit of the plan/ folder (only if the workspace is a git repo). Keeps plans versioned/diffable.

vizier.planTrackerWebhook.description: Deprecated: use vizier.tracker.* instead. When set and vizier.tracker.type is empty, the plan-progress report is POSTed here after each 'Check Plan Progress'.

vizier.tracker.type.description: Where to sync plan tasks after 'Check Plan Progress'. 'webhook' POSTs the plan JSON; 'jira'/'linear'/'github' create real issues. Leave empty to disable.

vizier.tracker.dryRun.description: When true, sync builds the issue payloads but does not call the remote API (useful to preview).

vizier.tracker.includeDone.description: When false, tasks already marked 'done' are skipped during sync.

vizier.tracker.jiraBaseUrl.description: Jira Cloud base URL, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net (tracker.type = 'jira').

vizier.tracker.jiraEmail.description: Jira account email for Basic auth (tracker.type = 'jira').

vizier.tracker.jiraToken.description: Jira API token. Also read from the 'vizier.tracker.jiraToken' secret if set.

vizier.tracker.linearToken.description: Linear personal API key. Also read from the 'vizier.tracker.linearToken' secret if set.

vizier.tracker.githubToken.description: GitHub personal access token (issues scope). Also read from the 'vizier.tracker.githubToken' secret if set.

vizier.requireReviewBeforeExport.description: Require an explicit 'I have reviewed this plan' acknowledgement in the UI before exporting, as a human-in-the-loop gate.

vizier.mcpEnabled.description: Expose Vizier's memory and AST tools to MCP clients over localhost SSE (Phase 3 bridge).

vizier.mcpPort.description: Local port for the MCP bridge. SSE endpoint: http://localhost:PORT/sse (client -> server: POST /messages).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run build:all
